+"""Record a fixed R1Pro trajectory that presses the living-room radio switch.
+
+This script is for the frozen turning_on_radio instance.  It records low-level
+actions from the exact initial state and saves them for open-loop replay.
+"""
+
+import json
+import math
+import os
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from rcb_behavior import Session
+from omnigibson.object_states.toggle import ToggledOn
+
+
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+RADIO = "radio_receiver.n.01_1"
+QUAT_TOWARD_RADIO = np.array([0.0, -math.sqrt(0.5), 0.0, math.sqrt(0.5)])
+
+
+def report(tag, session, radio):
+    button = radio.states[ToggledOn]
+    marker = button.visual_marker.get_position_orientation()[0]
+    eef = session.robot_state()["eef"]["right"]
+    base = session.robot_state()["base_pose"]
+    print(
+        tag,
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "status": session.status(),
+                "base": np.round(base[:3], 4).tolist(),
+                "right_eef": np.round(eef[:3], 4).tolist(),
+                "marker": np.round(marker.cpu().numpy(), 4).tolist(),
+                "finger_contact": radio in button._finger_contact_objs,
+                "marker_overlap": button._check_overlap(),
+                "contact_steps": button.robot_can_toggle_steps,
+            }
+        ),
+        flush=True,
+    )
+
+
+def main():
+    session = Session("turning_on_radio", instance="/app/instance.json", cameras="tiny")
+    primitive = session.primitives()
+    radio = session.get_object(RADIO)
+    session.record_start()
+
+    primitive["move_base"](4.35, 5.30, math.pi, max_lin=0.035, max_ang=0.07)
+    report("BASE", session, radio)
+
+    primitive["move_ee"]("right", [3.84, 5.30, 0.525], QUAT_TOWARD_RADIO, max_dq=0.04, settle=8)
+    primitive["hold"](30)
+    report("PRE", session, radio)
+
+    primitive["move_ee"]("right", [3.72, 5.28, 0.525], QUAT_TOWARD_RADIO, max_dq=0.015, settle=35)
+    report("PRESS", session, radio)
+    primitive["close_gripper"]("right", steps=35)
+    report("CLOSED", session, radio)
+
+    # The gripper pad overlaps the switch marker here.  Advance the whole hand
+    # in small increments until the radio makes physical contact for five steps.
+    for x in [4.345, 4.342, 4.339, 4.336, 4.333, 4.330, 4.327, 4.324]:
+        if session.episode_done:
+            break
+        primitive["move_base"](
+            x, 5.299, math.pi,
+            max_lin=0.0015, max_ang=0.01, tol=0.0004,
+            tol_yaw=0.05, max_steps=30,
+        )
+        primitive["hold"](10)
+        report(f"NUDGE {x}", session, radio)
+
+    actions = session.record_stop()
+    session.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"source": "fresh live recording", "success": session.status()["success"]})
+    report("SAVED", session, radio)
+    print("ACTIONS", actions.shape, OUT, flush=True)
+    os._exit(0 if session.status()["success"] else 2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
